description_en: Queries the departments of an identity provider by page
name: ListIdentityProviderDepartments

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace to which the identity provider belongs
parameters.help_zh: 身份源所属的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the identity provider. A value of DingTalk indicates DingTalk, and a value of Feishu indicates Feishu
parameters.help_zh: 身份源类型。DingTalk 表示钉钉，Feishu 表示飞书
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent department. Specifies the department whose direct child departments you want to query. If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the root hierarchy is queried without recursively returning all descendants. When expanding a node in the list, specify the ID of the node instead of its parentId
parameters.help_zh: 查询该部门的直接子部门；不传或为空时查询根层级，不递归返回所有后代。展开列表中的某个节点时，传该节点的 id，不是它的 parentId
parameters.name: parent_department_id

parameters.help_en: The number of departments to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的部门条数，取值 1～50，默认 50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The next token returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. To continue pagination, keep the identity provider and parentDepartmentId unchanged and pass the token as is. If the returned value is empty or not returned, it indicates that there are no subsequent pages at the current hierarchy
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的 nextToken。首次查询不传；继续分页时保持身份源和 parentDepartmentId 不变，并原样传入令牌。返回为空或不返回表示当前层级无后续页
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The business status code of the API request. A value of SUCCESS indicates that the request is successful, but does not indicate that the asynchronous synchronization task is completed
code.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的业务状态码。SUCCESS 表示本次请求成功，不表示异步同步任务已经完成

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the API request. This code does not indicate the execution result of an asynchronous task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的 HTTP 状态码，不表示异步任务的执行结果

items.description_en: The direct child departments on the current page under the parent department. You must query the details of the child departments separately
items.description_zh: 当前父部门下本页的直接子部门；子部门明细需另行查询

items.description_en: A department node returned by the identity provider. It does not include the list of recursively expanded child nodes
items.description_zh: 身份源返回的一个部门节点，不包含递归展开的子节点列表

hasChildren.description_en: Indicates whether child departments exist. A value of true indicates that child departments exist and an expansion entry can be displayed. A value of false indicates a leaf node. If this field is not returned, the status is unknown. To query the details of child departments, use the ID of the current node
hasChildren.description_zh: true 表示有子部门，可据此显示展开入口；false 表示叶子节点；不返回表示未知。子部门明细需使用当前节点 id 另行查询

id.description_en: The unique identifier of the department returned by the identity provider. When querying the child departments of this node, use this value as parentDepartmentId
id.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门唯一标识。查询该节点的子部门时，将此值作为 parentDepartmentId

memberCount.description_en: The number of members in the department returned by the identity provider. This value is not returned when unknown. Do not treat a missing value as 0
memberCount.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门成员数量；未知时不返回，不应将缺失值视为 0

name.description_en: The name of the department returned by the identity provider
name.description_zh: 身份源返回的部门名称

parentId.description_en: The ID of the parent department to which this department belongs. This value describes the parent-child relationship and is not used to expand the current node
parentId.description_zh: 该部门所属父部门的 ID；该值描述父子关系，不用于展开当前节点

maxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page used for this query
maxResults.description_zh: 本次查询使用的每页条数

message.description_en: The response message of the API request
message.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的响应消息

nextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. An empty or missing value indicates that there are no subsequent pages at the current hierarchy of the parent department, but does not indicate that the entire department tree has been returned
nextToken.description_zh: 后续页令牌。为空或不返回表示该父部门的当前层级无后续页，不表示整棵部门树已返回

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. Provide this value when troubleshooting issues
requestId.description_zh: 请求的唯一标识。排查问题时请提供该值

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API request is successful. To check whether an asynchronous task is completed, query the task status
success.description_zh: 本次 API 请求是否成功。异步任务是否完成应查询任务状态

totalCount.description_en: The total number of departments. This API does not provide this statistic. The value may not be returned and must not be treated as 0
totalCount.description_zh: 部门总数；当前接口不提供该统计，可能不返回，不能按 0 处理
